help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Reduces recharge time of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Recharge.Scale}% and gives the power a chance to Hold the target.  This enhancement's chance to trigger is equal to approximately 4 times per minute.
power_display_names: Superior Blistering Cold: Recharge/Chance for Hold
